info.title: Nautiq retained event evidence API
info.description: Fixed-reference diagnostic candidates. Sparse profile points remain isolated or regional profile groups, never dense heatwave polygons. No scientific event approval or live alerts. Unknown, repeated and malformed query parameters are refused.
